scoring.quests: End of the game: VP from Quests
scoring.companions: End of the game: VP from Companions
scoring.items: End of the game: VP from Items
scoring.skills: End of the game: VP from skills

1.name: Building
1.note: Buildings cannot be bought or recruited: they remain in the Village after being activated and may be used by other adjacent Villagers, including those belonging to a player who already activated them. They can be activated multiple times during the same year.

2.name: Item
2.note: An Item is bought and placed to the right of your player board. With some exceptions, you are limited to 3 Items: should you exceed this limit by buying an Item, discard an Item of your choice, exhausted or not (including the one you just acquired, after scoring any immediate VP it may provide).

3.name: Companion
3.note: A Companion costs 7 <coin/> to recruit and is placed to the left of your player board. It grants you 1 <villager>Villager</villager>, immediately available, but reduces your income in Autumn by 1 coin. You can never recruit more than 3 Companions during the game.

tell-story.name: Tell a story
tell-story.note: Tell a story using one or more Encounter cards you previously resolved, without exceeding a maximum storytelling value of 3 — exception: two stories each with a storytelling value of 2 still count only as a value-3 story. The rewards are cumulative: if the total storytelling value is 1, gain only the first bonus; if it is 2, the first two bonuses; if it is 3, all bonuses.

potion.name: Potion
potion.note: Potion: it must be discarded after use and returned to the box — unless Selia lets you exhaust it instead of discarding it.

seals.label: Seals
seals.spent: There is no <seal/> token left on this card: it cannot be activated again this year.
seals.note-players: When revealed, this card receives a number of <seal/> tokens equal to the number of players minus 1. Each activation uses one of them, which is then discarded.
seals.note-one: When revealed, this card receives only one <seal/> token, regardless of player count.

village-deck.name: Village deck
village-deck.note: Each Winter, the top 9 cards of the Village deck are revealed and laid out in a 3×3 grid. The back shows the period: I for the first 2 years, II for the next 2, III for the last one.

encounter.name: Encounter
encounter.note: An Encounter card is resolved from the space where your <adventurer>Adventurer</adventurer> stopped, by meeting its requirement to gain its reward. After resolving it, slide it into the Untold Stories column on your player board.
encounter.both: This Encounter has two requirements and two rewards: you must meet at least one of the two to resolve it. If you meet only the left requirement, you gain only the left reward; you may also meet both requirements to gain both rewards.
encounter.story-only: This Encounter has no reward: it only pays off when you tell it.
encounter.untellable: Storytelling value 0: you may not tell this Encounter, unless you increase its value (Charisma potion, Seren) or to complete the Bards' Tournament Quest.

income-token.name: Income token
income-token.note: Income token: after resolving an Encounter card with an Income token, place it on your player board and immediately resolve its effect. You also resolve it again during the Income step in Autumn. The number of Income tokens is not limited.

encounter-deck.name: Encounter deck
encounter-deck.note: Each Winter, the top 5/6/7 Encounter cards (2/3/4 players) are revealed and laid out to the right of the main board according to their Distance. The back shows the period: I for the first 2 years, II for the next 2, III for the last one.

event.name: Event
event.note: Once per year, in Spring or in Summer, you may participate in the Event as an action: place one of your active <villager>Villagers</villager> — or, in Summer, one of your Villagers currently in the Village — on the Event tile, and be able to activate it (paying any cost if applicable) to gain its benefits.
event.festival: Festival: choose an empty space on the tile and gain the 2 adjacent bonuses. Your <villager>Villager</villager> stays there until Autumn.

event-pile.name: Event stack
event-pile.note: During setup, one Event tile is removed at random and the remaining 5 tiles are secretly shuffled to form the stack. Each Winter, the top tile of the stack is revealed: this is the active Event for the current year.

quest.name: Heroic Quest
quest.note: After your <adventurer>Adventurer</adventurer> arrives on a Heroic Quest space, you may choose not to resolve an Encounter and instead resolve the Quest, if you have not done it yet and meet its conditions. If you are the first player to do so, place one of your Quest markers on the space worth the most end-game VP; otherwise, place it on the adjacent space: multiple markers (from different players) may be on that space.
quest.score: You may resolve each Quest only once. Its VP are only added at the end of the game, after the fifth year.

companions.name: Companions
companions.text: Your Companions are placed to the left of your player board. Their Reaction ability, at the bottom of the card, requires exhausting them; their Permanent ability is active whether the Companion is exhausted or not.

items.name: Items
items.text: Your Items are placed to the right of your player board. Most of them have an ability that requires spending a Summer action to use, by exhausting the card; Potions must be discarded after use. In Autumn, ready all your cards.

stories.name: Stories
stories.text: After resolving each Encounter card, slide it into the Untold Stories column on your player board. Once a story is told, move the card(s) to the right, into the Told Stories area: you may not tell those stories again for the rest of the game.

income.name: Income
income.text: In Autumn, gain your income: 3 <coin/>, minus 1 <coin/> per Companion, plus any gains from the Income tokens placed on your player board.

skills.name: Strength and Magic
skills.text: The red track is your Strength, the blue one your Magic: both markers start the game on their bottom space. Cards and Quests sometimes require you to have at least a certain level of Strength or Magic, sometimes to spend it.
skills.score: At the end of the game, you score 2 VP if you have at least 3 Strength and 3 Magic, or 5 VP if you have 5 Strength and 5 Magic.

special-action.name: Special action
special-action.text: This special space, usable only in Summer, allows you to place 1 of your active <villager>Villagers</villager> to do one of the following. It stays there until Autumn.

quests.name: Quest markers
quests.text: During setup, your 3 Heroic Quest markers are placed on these spaces. Each time you resolve a Heroic Quest, you place one of them on one of the spaces below its tile, on the main board: you therefore cannot resolve more than 3.

villagers.name: Active Villagers
villagers.text: The Villagers you control at the start of each year are called “active” and are located in this area of your player board, as are those you gain during the year. In Autumn, return your Villagers from the Campsite, the Event and the special action to this area.

score.name: Score track
score.text: The <vp/> scored during the game advance your marker on the score track, which starts again from 0 after 24. When you reach 25, 50, 75 and then 100 VP, take or flip your 25/50 and 75/100 VP tokens.
score.note: At the end of the fifth year, add to the VP gained during the game the VP from Quests, Companions and Items, and from your skills: 2 VP if you have at least 3 Strength and 3 Magic, 5 VP if you have 5 Strength and 5 Magic.

bonus.name: Bonus tokens
bonus.text: When you reach 8 VP, choose one of your 3 Bonus tokens, resolve its effect and return it to the box. When you reach 20 VP, do the same with one of your 2 remaining tokens.

village.name: Village
village.text: During setup, each player places their <adventurer>Adventurer</adventurer> in the Village. When you go on an adventure, your Adventurer first moves from the Village; during the same year, it then moves from the space where it last stopped. In Autumn, it returns to the Village.

road.name: Going on an adventure
road.text: When you travel, you may move your <adventurer>Adventurer</adventurer> up to the indicated number of spaces, in the direction of your choice, or stay where you are. Multiple Adventurers may be on the same space. The crest in the top-left corner of each Encounter card indicates where to place it: to the right of the board, next to the space bearing the same crest.

stops.name: Coin and VP
stops.text: After your <adventurer>Adventurer</adventurer> arrives on the space marked with a <coin/>, you may choose not to resolve an Encounter to gain 1 <coin/>. On the space marked with a <vp/>, you may do the same to gain 1 <vp/>.

quests.name: Heroic Quests
quests.text: The 3 Heroic Quest tiles of the game are placed face up on the 3 spaces of the board, near the spaces farthest from the Village. The end-game VP they are worth are printed below each space: 7 and 5, 8 and 6, then 9 and 7 <vp/>, from the nearest space to the farthest.

event.name: Event
event.text: The Event stack is placed face down on this space. Each Winter, the previous year's Event tile is discarded and the top tile of the stack is revealed: this is the active Event for the current year.

markers.name: Season markers
markers.text: On your turn, you must choose one of the actions allowed by the season you are currently in: this is what your Season marker shows. Some players may be in Summer or Autumn while others are still in Spring. A player who is in Summer can never return to Spring during the same year, and a year ends only when all players have reached Autumn.

winter.name: Winter
winter.text: Winter is the setup phase of the year. Skip it for the first year: it has already been done during initial setup.
winter.0: Place each player's Season marker on the Spring space
winter.1: The First Player passes the 1st Player token to the player on their left
winter.2: Discard the Village cards, Encounter cards, and the Event tile from the previous year, as well as any Seal or Income tokens on them
winter.3: Reveal the top 9 cards of the Village deck in a 3×3 grid, and place the <seal/> tokens they require on them
winter.4: Reveal the top tile of the Event stack: this is the active Event for the current year
winter.5: Reveal the top 5/6/7 Encounter cards (2/3/4 players) and lay them out to the right of the main board according to their Distance

spring.name: Spring
spring.0: Place a Villager: take one of your active <villager>Villagers</villager> and place it in the Village between two adjacent cards, or between a card and an empty card space
spring.1: Participate in the Event, once per year, with one of your active <villager>Villagers</villager>
spring.2: Move to Summer and immediately take a Summer action

summer.name: Summer
summer.0: Gain coins: choose one of your <villager>Villagers</villager> in the Village and a card adjacent to it, and gain 1 <coin/> for each other Villager adjacent to that card, regardless of owner
summer.1: Activate a card: choose one of your <villager>Villagers</villager> in the Village and a card adjacent to it, and pay its price + 1 <coin/> for each other Villager adjacent to that card, regardless of owner
summer.2: Participate in the Event, once per year, with one of your active <villager>Villagers</villager> or one of your Villagers currently in the Village
summer.3: Use one of your readied Items, by exhausting it
summer.4: Use the special action on your player board
summer.5: Move to Autumn and immediately take an Autumn action, only if you no longer have any <villager>Villagers</villager> left in the Village

autumn.name: Autumn
autumn.text: Once in Autumn, you may no longer take any actions during that year, and you immediately resolve the following steps in order.
autumn.1: Return your <villager>Villagers</villager> from the Campsite, the Event and the special action to the Active Villagers area of your player board
autumn.3: Gain your income: 3 <coin/>, minus 1 <coin/> per Companion, plus any gains from your Income tokens

camp.name: Campsite
camp.text: Whenever one of your <villager>Villagers</villager> is used up and becomes inactive, place it in the Campsite to indicate you cannot use it anymore this year. The Villagers you spend, taken from your Active Villagers area, also go there. In Autumn, they return to that area.

villager-reserve.name: Villager supply
villager-reserve.text: During setup, 4 of your 7 <villager>Villagers</villager> are set aside and are not available yet: you start the game with 3 active Villagers. Each time you gain a <villager>Villager</villager>, it comes from here and joins the Active Villagers area of your player board. The Deadly trap Quest makes you return one of your available Villagers to this supply.

adventurer.name: Adventurer
adventurer.travel: When you travel, you may move your Adventurer up to the indicated number of spaces, in the direction of your choice (you may also choose to stay where you are), and resolve an Encounter on your destination space, if possible. Multiple Adventurers may be on the same space.

villager.name: Villager
villager.active: The Villagers you control at the start of each year are called “active” and are always located in the “Active Villagers” area of your player board, as are those you gain during the year.

coin.name: Coins
coin.text: Each player starts the game with 8 coins. The coins form a general supply and are considered unlimited.

seal.name: Seal token
seal.building: The cost or effect of some Buildings depends on the value of a Seal token. You can only exploit such a Building if at least one token remains on the card. In that case, choose one of the tokens, use its value for the activation, and discard it. A Building card stays in the Village even if there are no tokens left on it.
seal.item: If you buy an Item on which a Seal token showing a VP value is placed, those VP are scored immediately.
seal.stack: The Seal tokens are placed face down near the main board. If there are not enough tokens left, shuffle the discard pile to form a new face-down pile.

first-player.name: 1st Player token
first-player.text: Players take their actions one at a time, in turn and clockwise, starting with the 1st player of each year, until they have all reached Autumn.

102.name: Scouts' guild
102.ability: Discard a <seal/> token and move your <adventurer>Adventurer</adventurer> up to a number of spaces equal to the token's value.

103.name: The Riven Oak
103.ability: Tell one or more stories with a total storytelling value of up to 3: 2 VP + 1 <force>Strength</force> + 1 <villager>Villager</villager>.

104.name: The Golden Lion
104.ability: Tell one or more stories with a total storytelling value of up to 3: 4 <coin/> + 1 VP + discard a <seal/> token and gain as many <coin/> as its value.

105.name: Magical school
105.ability: Discard a <seal/> token, pay that many <coin/> and gain 1 <magic>Magic</magic>.

107.name: Travelers' guild
107.ability: Pay 2 <coin/> and move your <adventurer>Adventurer</adventurer> up to 4 spaces.

108.name: Scouts' guild
108.ability: Discard a <seal/> token and move your <adventurer>Adventurer</adventurer> up to a number of spaces equal to the token's value.

109.name: Hall of the heroes
109.ability: Spend 1 <force>Strength</force> to gain 3 VP, and/or spend 1 <magic>Magic</magic> to gain 4 VP.

110.name: Town hall
110.ability: Discard a <seal/> token, pay that many <coin/> and gain 1 <force>Strength</force> and 1 <magic>Magic</magic>.

111.name: The Silver Wolf
111.ability: Tell one or more stories with a total storytelling value of up to 3: 4 <coin/> + discard a <seal/> token and gain as many VP as its value + ready one of your cards.

112.name: The Jolly Boar
112.ability: Tell one or more stories with a total storytelling value of up to 3: 3 VP + 2 <coin/> + 1 <force>Strength</force> or 1 <magic>Magic</magic>.

113.name: Fortress
113.ability: Discard a <seal/> token, pay that many <coin/> and gain 2 VP per Companion you have.

114.name: Travelers' guild
114.ability: Pay 2 <coin/> and move your <adventurer>Adventurer</adventurer> up to 5 spaces.

115.name: Library
115.ability: Discard a <seal/> token, pay that many <coin/> and gain 1 VP per story told.

116.name: The Scarlet Dragon
116.ability: Tell one or more stories with a total storytelling value of up to 3: 3 VP + 2 VP + 1 VP.

202.name: Tommy
202.ability: Exhaust this card to move your <adventurer>Adventurer</adventurer> up to 1 space, OR exhaust this card and spend 1 <villager>Villager</villager> to move it up to 2 spaces.

203.name: Hundred-league boots
203.immediate: Discard the <seal/> token and gain VP equal to its value.
203.ability: Exhaust this card and discard it to move your <adventurer>Adventurer</adventurer> up to 5 spaces.

204.name: Wizard's staff
204.ability: Exhaust this card and spend 1 <villager>Villager</villager> to gain 1 <magic>Magic</magic>.

205.name: Mysterious map
205.ability: Exhaust this card to move your <adventurer>Adventurer</adventurer> up to 1 space, OR exhaust this card, spend 1 <villager>Villager</villager> and discard this card to move it up to 3 spaces.

206.name: Mana potion
206.immediate: Discard the <seal/> token and gain VP equal to its value.
206.reaction: When you go adventuring, you may discard this card to increase your Magic by 2. This increase is temporary and you don't move your Magic marker: you cannot spend these points.

207.name: Strength potion
207.immediate: Discard the <seal/> token and gain VP equal to its value.
207.reaction: When you go adventuring, you may discard this card to increase your Strength by 2. This increase is temporary and you don't move your Strength marker: you cannot spend these points.

208.name: Short sword
208.ability: Exhaust this card and spend 1 <villager>Villager</villager> to gain 1 <force>Strength</force>.

210.name: Snowmane
210.ability: Exhaust this card and spend 1 or 2 <villager>Villagers</villager> to move your <adventurer>Adventurer</adventurer> up to 3 or 5 spaces.

211.name: Horn
211.ability: Exhaust this card and spend 1 or 2 <villager>Villagers</villager> to score 3 or 5 VP.

212.name: Treasure map
212.ability: Exhaust this card to move your <adventurer>Adventurer</adventurer> up to 2 spaces, OR exhaust this card, spend 1 <villager>Villager</villager> and discard this card to move it up to 4 spaces.

213.name: Charisma potion
213.immediate: Discard the <seal/> token and gain VP equal to its value.
213.reaction: When you tell a story, you may discard this card to make the storytelling value of one of your Encounter cards equal to 3.

214.name: Endurance potion
214.immediate: Discard the <seal/> token and gain VP equal to its value.
214.reaction: When you go adventuring, you may discard this card to place 1 active <villager>Villager</villager> in the Village.

215.name: Flying potion
215.immediate: Discard the <seal/> token and gain VP equal to its value.
215.reaction: When you go adventuring, you may discard this card to increase your Strength and Magic by 1. This increase is temporary and you don't move your Strength and Magic markers: you cannot spend these points.

216.name: Bladechant
216.ability: Exhaust this card to gain 1 <force>Strength</force> or 1 <magic>Magic</magic>, OR exhaust this card and spend 1 <villager>Villager</villager> to gain 1 <force>Strength</force> AND 1 <magic>Magic</magic>.

217.name: Invisibility potion
217.immediate: Discard the <seal/> token and gain VP equal to its value.
217.reaction: When you go adventuring, you may discard this card to ignore one requirement on an Encounter card.

219.name: Mandolin
219.ability: Exhaust this card and spend 1 <villager>Villager</villager> to score 1 VP per untold story.

220.name: Bag of holding
220.ability: Exhaust this card and spend 1 <villager>Villager</villager> to gain 1 VP per Item you have.
220.permanent: Your Item limit is increased by 1. This effect works even if this card is exhausted and if you were already at your Item limit before acquiring it.

221.name: Philosopher stone
221.immediate: Discard the <seal/> token and gain VP equal to its value.
221.ability: Exhaust this card and spend 1 <villager>Villager</villager> to gain 5 VP.

301.name: Kael
301.reaction: When you must spend Strength, you may exhaust this card to spend 1 less.
301.permanent: Your Item limit is increased by 1.

302.name: Elwen
302.reaction: When you go adventuring, you may exhaust this card to move your <adventurer>Adventurer</adventurer> up to 2 additional spaces.
302.score: 1 VP per Encounter card with a distance of 3 or more from the Village (told or untold).

303.name: Dorian
303.reaction: When you buy an Item, you may exhaust this card to reduce its cost by 1 <coin/> and gain 1 VP.
303.permanent: Your Item limit is increased by 2.

304.name: Ariok
304.reaction: When you go adventuring, you may exhaust this card and spend 1 <magic>Magic</magic> to ignore one requirement on an Encounter card.

305.name: Selia
305.reaction: When you activate a <seal/> token, you may exhaust this card to choose its value (1 to 3).
305.permanent: When you use a Potion, exhaust it instead of discarding it. Reminder: you may use multiple Potions in the same turn.

306.name: Neris
306.reaction: When you remove a <villager>Villager</villager> from the Village, you may exhaust this card to gain 2 additional <coin/> or to ignore the extra cost.

307.name: Bran
307.reaction: When you must spend one or more <villager>Villagers</villager> to activate one of your cards, you may exhaust this card to reduce that number by 1.
307.score: VP = number of <villager>Villagers</villager> available to you, minus 2.

308.name: Lucan
308.reaction: When you gain Magic, you may exhaust this card to gain 1 <force>Strength</force> (or vice versa).
308.score: VP = level of your lower skill (Strength or Magic).

309.name: Isandre
309.reaction: When you exhaust one of your cards, you may exhaust this card to ready it. You may immediately exhaust the card you just readied to trigger its effect again.

310.name: Seren
310.reaction: When you tell a story, you may exhaust this card to make the storytelling value of one of your Encounter cards equal to 3.

311.name: Mira
311.reaction: When you go adventuring (before or after resolving an Encounter), you may exhaust this card to place 1 active <villager>Villager</villager> in the Village.
311.score: 1 VP per Encounter card with a different crest (told or untold).

tuto.goal:
In this game, you play as an <bold>Adventurer</bold>.
Your goal is to become the most prestigious figure in Greylune by earning the most Victory Points <vp/> at the end of <bold>five years</bold> of play.
tuto.seasons: Each year is divided into <bold>4 seasons</bold>. Winter <winter/> is the setup, which is automatic.
tuto.spring: You and your opponent are in <bold>Spring</bold> <spring/>.
tuto.villagers: In Spring, you place your <bold>Villagers</bold>. You start with 3 Villagers, and can recruit up to 4 more.
tuto.village:
Villagers can be placed in the <bold>Village</bold>, between 2 cards. In Summer, this will let you benefit from one of the 2 adjacent cards.
<italic>There are many cards in the game, all unique. On Game Park, click on any element to open the player aid!</italic>
tuto.place-first: Place your first Villager here, next to <bold>Dorian</bold>.
tuto.opponent-turn: It is your opponent's turn, William.
tuto.place-second: Place your second Villager here, between <bold>Tommy</bold> and <bold>The Riven Oak</bold>.
tuto.go-summer: You still have a third Villager, but nothing forces you to place it. Choose to <bold>move to Summer</bold> <summer/>.
tuto.summer:
Your <bold>Season marker</bold> is moved to Summer. In this season, you can no longer place Villagers in the Village.
<italic>Your opponent stays in Spring.</italic>
tuto.recruit:
In Summer, you can use a Villager placed in the Village to <bold>activate</bold> one of the 2 adjacent cards.
For example, this Villager can recruit this Companion, <bold>Dorian</bold>, for <bold>7 <coin/></bold>. Do it.
tuto.starting-coins:
You start the game with <bold>8 <coin/></bold>.
<italic>Coins are used to recruit Companions, buy Items, and activate some Buildings, Events or Encounters.</italic>
tuto.companions: Your <bold>Companions</bold> go here. You can have at most 3 of them.
tuto.new-villager: Moreover, when you recruit a Companion, you immediately gain a new <bold>Villager</bold> <villager/>.
tuto.opponent-guild: It is your opponent's turn. He moves to Summer, and uses this Villager to use the <bold>Scouts' guild</bold>.
tuto.seal:
This Building bears a <bold>Seal</bold> <seal/>: its effect depends on the value of this Seal (between 1 and 3). Here, William can go on an adventure up to a distance of 1.
<italic>With 3 or 4 players, there would be 2 or 3 Seals.</italic>
tuto.camp: Once used, the Villager goes here, to the <bold>Campsite</bold>. It will be available again next year.
tuto.opponent-travel: William <bold>goes on an adventure</bold>: he moves his <bold>Adventurer</bold> <adventurer/>, here up to 1 space.
tuto.opponent-encounter: On this space, William can gain 1 <coin/> or resolve an <bold>Encounter</bold> card. He chooses to resolve the <bold>Tiger</bold>.
tuto.untold-stories: He sends an active Villager to the Campsite, and the Tiger goes to his <bold>untold stories</bold>!
tuto.banquet:
Your turn. Each year, an <bold>Event</bold> takes place in Greylune. This year, it is the <bold>Banquet</bold>.
Click on it to see its effect, then send an active Villager there to gain 3 <coin/>.
tuto.opponent-tavern:
William now wants to use <bold>The Riven Oak</bold> to tell the story of his encounter with the Tiger!
However, to activate a Village card, you must pay <bold>1 <coin/> for each other Villager</bold> adjacent to that card… So William pays 1 <coin/>.
tuto.tell-story: To <bold>tell a story</bold>, William must choose one or more untold stories and move them to his told stories.
tuto.tavern-rewards: William told a story with a storytelling value of 3: he therefore gains all 3 bonuses of the <bold>Tavern</bold>: 2 <vp/> + 1 <force/> + 1 <villager/>.
tuto.force: William will gain 1 <bold>Strength</bold> <force/>: his Strength marker therefore moves up. Strength and <bold>Magic</bold> <magic/> are often requirements to resolve Encounters and Quests!
tuto.skills-score:
At the end of the game, you gain <bold>2 <vp/></bold> if you have at least 3 <force/> and 3 <magic/>, and <bold>5 <vp/></bold> if you have 5 <force/> and 5 <magic/>.
<italic>Moreover, each <force/> or <magic/> gained beyond 5 immediately gives 1 <vp/>.</italic>
tuto.reaction: Some Companions and some Items can be activated <bold>as a reaction</bold>. For example, when you buy an Item, you may exhaust <bold>Dorian</bold> to reduce its cost by 1 <coin/>, and gain 1 <vp/>. Do it.
tuto.score-track: When you gain Victory Points, your marker advances on the <bold>score track</bold>. When you reach 8 and then 20 <vp/>, you immediately gain a bonus!
tuto.bonus-tokens:
Your 3 <bold>Bonus tokens</bold> are here. At 8 <vp/>, you choose one, gain what it offers, and discard it.
At 20 <vp/>, you choose a second one, and discard the last one.
tuto.items:
Your <bold>Items</bold> go here. You can have at most 3 of them, but Dorian lets you have 2 more!
Dorian will also give you 1 <vp/> per Item you have at the end of the game.
tuto.tommy-score: <bold>Tommy</bold> will also give you 1 <vp/> at the end of the game.
tuto.opponent-banquet: William used his last active Villager to participate in the Event, and gain 3 <coin/>.
tuto.special-action: In Summer, once per year, you can use a Villager to take your <bold>special action</bold> <special/>: tell a story to gain 2 <coin/> + 1 <force/> + 2 <vp/>, go on an adventure up to 1 space <travel1/>, or gain 1 <magic/>.
tuto.use-tommy:
In Summer, you can also use your Items: <bold>Tommy</bold>, for example, lets you go on an adventure!
Exhaust it by spending an active Villager to move your Adventurer up to 2 spaces <travel2/>.
tuto.sheep: Here, you can choose between gaining 1 <vp/> or resolving an Encounter. Choose to resolve the <bold>Sheep</bold> Encounter.
tuto.income-token: You gained this <bold>Income token</bold>: 1 <coin/> immediately, then 1 <coin/> each year.
tuto.opponent-autumn: William has no Villagers left: he moves to <bold>Autumn</bold> <autumn/>. His Adventurer returns to Greylune, he retrieves his Villagers and gains 3 <coin/>.
tuto.autumn: Your turn: you have no possible action left, move to <bold>Autumn</bold> <autumn/>.
tuto.come-home: Your Adventurer returns to Greylune, you retrieve your <bold>Villagers</bold>, and you ready your Companion and Item cards.
tuto.income: You also gain your <bold>income</bold> <income/>: 3 <coin/>, minus 1 <coin/> per Companion (Dorian costs you 1 <coin/>), plus your Income tokens (1 <coin/> for the Sheep).
tuto.end-of-year:
Once in Autumn, players can no longer take actions, and must wait for the other players to finish their year.
Once everyone is in Autumn, a <bold>new year</bold> begins!
tuto.new-village: In <bold>Winter</bold> <winter/>, the remaining <bold>Village</bold> cards are replaced by 9 new Village cards.
tuto.new-encounters: 5 new <bold>Encounters</bold> replace the previous ones (number of players + 3).
tuto.new-year: Finally, all players move to <bold>Spring</bold> <spring/>, and the 1st Player token passes to the next player: a new year can begin!
tuto.periods: In years 3 and 4, the Village and Encounter cards will be from <bold>period II</bold> (more powerful, but with more requirements), and in year 5, from <bold>period III</bold>, to score as many <vp/> as possible before the end of the game!
tuto.quests:
To gain a lot of <vp/>, you can also complete the <bold>Heroic Quests</bold> <quest/>.
To do so, go on an adventure, and once on a Quest space, choose to resolve it instead of an Encounter.
<italic>The <vp/> from Quests are scored at the end of the game.</italic>
tuto.first-quest:
The <bold>first player</bold> to resolve a Quest gains 2 more <vp/>!
<italic>You can resolve each Quest only once during the game.</italic>
tuto.good-luck:
The most prestigious player at the end of the 5th year wins!
Now it is up to you to forge your destiny, noble adventurer!
